title: 二元一次方程组
summary: 根据已知和差关系求两个未知数的值
scene_svg:
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="paperGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fdfbf7"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f5efe6"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="redGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fee2e2"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fca5a5"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
    <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.18"/>
  </filter>
  <filter id="redGlow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
    <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="0" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#8a1c1c" flood-opacity="0.28"/>
  </filter>
  <style>
    .ink{fill:#1f2937;font-family:KaiTi,STKaiti,serif}
    .subink{fill:#44403c;font-family:KaiTi,STKaiti,serif}
    .lightink{fill:#78716c;font-family:KaiTi,STKaiti,serif}
    .redink{fill:#8a1c1c;font-family:KaiTi,STKaiti,serif}
    .stroke-ink{stroke:#1f2937}
    .stroke-sub{stroke:#44403c}
    .stroke-light{stroke:#78716c}
    .stroke-red{stroke:#8a1c1c}
    .dashed-line{stroke:#78716c;stroke-width:2.5;stroke-dasharray:8 8;fill:none;opacity:.9}
    .card{fill:url(#paperGrad);stroke:#d6d3d1;stroke-width:1.5;filter:url(#softShadow)}
    .hl{fill:url(#redGrad);opacity:.8;filter:url(#redGlow)}
    .floaty{animation:floaty 3s ease-in-out infinite}
    .pulseRed{animation:pulseRed 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
    .shine{animation:shine 2.6s linear infinite}
    .fadeText{animation:fadeText 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
    @keyframes floaty{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0px)}50%{transform:translateY(-7px)}}
    @keyframes pulseRed{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.05)}}
    @keyframes shine{0%{opacity:.55}50%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:.55}}
    @keyframes fadeText{0%,100%{opacity:.75}50%{opacity:1}}
  </style>
</defs>
<g>
  <g transform="translate(60,60)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" rx="22" ry="22" width="680" height="480" class="card"/>

    <g x-show="sceneStep >= 1" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-800 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 -translate-y-6" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0">
      <text x="40" y="55" class="ink" font-size="30" font-weight="700">二元一次方程组</text>
      <text x="40" y="95" class="subink fadeText" font-size="22">已知两个式子，一步步找到 x 和 y</text>
    </g>

    <g x-show="sceneStep >= 1" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-700 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-95" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
      <rect x="45" y="130" width="260" height="150" rx="16" class="card"/>
      <text x="75" y="180" class="ink" font-size="30">①  x + y = 7</text>
      <text x="75" y="235" class="ink" font-size="30">②  2x − y = 5</text>
      <circle cx="265" cy="175" r="18" fill="#fee2e2" class="pulseRed"/>
      <text x="257" y="182" class="redink" font-size="20">①</text>
    </g>

    <g x-show="sceneStep >= 2" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-900 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-x-10" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-x-0">
      <path d="M305 175 C360 175, 380 165, 430 155" class="dashed-line"/>
      <path d="M430 155 C470 150, 510 145, 560 145" class="dashed-line"/>
      <rect x="430" y="105" width="200" height="95" rx="16" class="card floaty"/>
      <text x="455" y="145" class="subink" font-size="22">由 ① 得</text>
      <rect x="448" y="155" width="140" height="30" rx="8" class="hl"/>
      <text x="460" y="178" class="redink" font-size="28" font-weight="700">y = 7 − x</text>
    </g>

    <g x-show="sceneStep >= 3" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-900 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-8" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0">
      <text x="420" y="245" class="subink" font-size="24">把 y = 7 − x 代入 ②</text>
      <path d="M515 188 C520 210, 510 220, 500 235" class="dashed-line"/>
      <rect x="395" y="265" width="250" height="60" rx="14" class="card"/>
      <text x="420" y="304" class="ink" font-size="28">2x − (7 − x) = 5</text>
    </g>

    <g x-show="sceneStep >= 4" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-800 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-90" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
      <text x="410" y="365" class="subink" font-size="22">去括号并合并同类项</text>
      <rect x="390" y="380" width="255" height="88" rx="16" class="card"/>
      <rect x="410" y="395" width="150" height="28" rx="8" class="hl"/>
      <text x="420" y="418" class="redink" font-size="28">2x − 7 + x = 5</text>
      <text x="470" y="453" class="ink shine" font-size="30" font-weight="700">3x = 12</text>
    </g>

    <g x-show="sceneStep >= 5" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-800 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-x-8" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-x-0">
      <path d="M518 468 C530 485, 540 495, 555 505" class="dashed-line"/>
      <rect x="470" y="485" width="145" height="42" rx="12" class="hl"/>
      <text x="495" y="514" class="redink pulseRed" font-size="30" font-weight="700">x = 4</text>
    </g>

    <g x-show="sceneStep >= 6" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-900 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 -translate-x-8" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-x-0">
      <path d="M535 506 C450 520, 360 515, 275 505" class="dashed-line"/>
      <rect x="70" y="315" width="255" height="145" rx="18" class="card"/>
      <text x="92" y="355" class="subink" font-size="22">代回 ①：x + y = 7</text>
      <text x="92" y="398" class="ink" font-size="28">4 + y = 7</text>
      <rect x="92" y="415" width="120" height="30" rx="8" class="hl"/>
      <text x="102" y="438" class="redink" font-size="28" font-weight="700">y = 3</text>
    </g>

    <g x-show="sceneStep >= 7" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-1000 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-90" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
      <rect x="355" y="90" width="285" height="420" rx="20" fill="#fffaf2" stroke="#e7e5e4" stroke-width="1.2" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
      <text x="445" y="130" class="ink" font-size="28" font-weight="700">验算</text>
      <text x="390" y="190" class="subink" font-size="25">① 4 + 3 = 7 ✓</text>
      <text x="390" y="255" class="subink" font-size="25">② 2×4 − 3 = 5 ✓</text>
      <rect x="405" y="325" width="190" height="42" rx="12" class="hl pulseRed"/>
      <text x="425" y="354" class="redink" font-size="30" font-weight="700">x = 4，y = 3</text>
      <text x="420" y="415" class="lightink floaty" font-size="38">🎉</text>
      <text x="455" y="415" class="subink" font-size="22">两个式子都成立</text>
    </g>

    <g x-show="sceneStep === 1">
      <text x="345" y="180" class="lightink" font-size="22">先观察：①里 y 的系数是 1，最容易单独写出来</text>
    </g>
    <g x-show="sceneStep === 2">
      <text x="445" y="85" class="lightink" font-size="20">把 ① 变形成“y 等于……”</text>
    </g>
    <g x-show="sceneStep === 3">
      <text x="620" y="302" class="lightink" font-size="20">代入后就只剩一个未知数啦</text>
    </g>
    <g x-show="sceneStep === 4">
      <text x="650" y="420" class="lightink" font-size="20">2x + x 合成 3x</text>
    </g>
    <g x-show="sceneStep >= 5">
      <text :x="sceneStep >= 7 ? 150 : 640" :y="sceneStep >= 7 ? 520 : 515" class="lightink" font-size="20">先求 x，再回代求 y</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</g>
